notes.title: BIG UPDATE: FIND MY LOVE - Version 2.0
notes.content:
BIG UPDATE TO VERSION 2.0

Hello lovely players!

We from Araujo Castle are proud to announce the new version of Find My Love. This new version has many changes and improvements, including a new lives system that makes the game more challenging, also was added more bad cards making the game harder. If you just want to play the game to relax, don´t worry, the relax mode is still the same, you can choose to play in any of our new 24 stages.

Check the list below with our big and small changes:

BIG CHANGES:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556057/b6106eb626a1fe45f2c53a721219f2c432e57a0e.jpg

New Lives system:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556057/1b49aa5549c3401ff700a77c536752a361128738.jpg

We added a new lives system to make the game challenging and harder to be finished. The rules is still simples, but now each 3 double flips without finding any couple you will lose a life, each 3 double flips finding 3 couples in a row you will gain a life. On firsts levels you start with 3 lives, on higher levels you will start the game with 4 or 5 lives. But thats not just this that will make the game harder, we also has added more...

New Bad Cards:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556057/8de3f27d0fe97545526f263b9fe714f12092ae13.jpg

We added 4 new bad cards that may be found in any level. The new cards is: The bad Ideologist male, The Junkie, The Home Destroyer and The Scoundrel. You may find any of these cards in any level, max of 2 bad cards per level.

New Levels in Normal Mode and Relax Mode:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556057/8b54dd630f4d808f2507e980045d3cbb821d4a0e.jpg

Now each mode has 24 levels instead of 10. Each level a new couple is added. In Normal Mode the first level has 4 cards and last level (24) has 50 cards. In Relax Mode, first level has 2 cards and last level (24) has 48 cards. You can´t lose the game in Relax Mode, just chill and relax while playing.

New Rank System:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556057/da4a167290c75fc83cdeb41fdefef1f813dda151.jpg

Now each level will calculate your points and gives you a score. After you clear the last level, the score of all levels will be added toghether and give you a final score. See below how to get or lose points:


 You gain 1 point for each couple found.

 You gain 2 extra points for each couple found in the first minute of each level.

 You gain 1 extra point for each couple found in the second minute of each level.

 You gain 1 extra point for each couple found in sequence of each turn. Ex: if you flip 2 cards and find a couple you get 1 point, in the next turn if you flip 2 cards and found another couple, you will get 2 points (1 for finding a couple and 1 extra point), in the next turn if you find another couple you will get 3 points (1 for finding a couple and 2 extra points) and also a life, next turn if you find more one couple, you get more 4 points, and go on until finding all couple in the level.

 You lose 1 point and a life if you find a bad card.


Also you will have a rating score from E to S. The score letters are: E, D, C, B-, B, B+, A-, A, A+ and S.

Bible Versicles added in Win Screen:

On the "You Win" screen, you can read a specail Bible Versicule that will help you have a very happy marriage. We from Araujo Castle desires all our players have very happy relationships and marriages.

SMALL CHANGES:
We made some changes to improve your experience in game:


 Added 2 animations at the start and end of each level. One animation for level start and other for level complete. These animations is pure cosmetic and doesn´t affect your gameplay.

 Added 20 more new beautiful backgrounds. 

 Added 7 more new BGMs.

 Improved and optimized the main resolution of the game as well as the in game camera. Now with zoom level at starting point, the screen will show the right resolution instead of showing more pixels like you were running the game game in resolutions above 1920x1080px and making your gameplay heavy.

 The basic resolution is screen size is 1920x1080px, other resolutions modes was removed. We are still working to add new resolutions again lower than 1920x1080px.

 A timer was added, press "T" to see how log you are playing in any level.

 A new scroll bar was added in the Card List page.


And thats all for while, don´t forget to give your opinions on comments or in our community.

See you later, lovely players,

Andre Araujo - King of Araujo Castle

notes.title: UPDATE TO VERSION V1007
notes.content:
Hello Lovely Players,


We have added a save and load system in game. Now you can save your progress and continue playing later. In any level press "Esc" and click the button "Save", the game will save your progress. In main menu click the button "Load" to load your game and you will continue the level you were from start.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556057/0a75e110484641b3ce31e9bfe91029638f926aed.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556057/b9f88d8897d726680bb3610ee47c7862951b4f41.jpg"]

What? So you thought you could trick the game and save the game in the middle of the level after flipping some cards, then if you flip the wrong card you could load the game to the 5 seconds earlier and try another card? Ha ha, nice try! But no way! This could change the final scores in game, and that is cheating! If you load game you will start the level you were from beginning again. Good players don´t do it!

Now prove you´re good and post your scores in our community!


More changes done:
We have improved the resolution appearance bug on some cards that appeared "broken" since last update, with some pixels distorced. Now, all images is shown in high quality.





Thank you all for playing Find My Love, please like this post, comment, be active in our community and leave a review in our game.



See you all!

notes.title: Update to Version 1.0.0.6
notes.content:
Hello Lovely Players,

We heard your feedback and improved the gameplay, check the notes below to see what changed in game:

RANDOM COUPLES IN EACH LEVEL:

Now the couple cards that will appear in each level is totally random. Before the couple cards were fixed, the couples 1, 2, 3 and 4, (King and Queen, Prince and Princess, Wizards and, Waiter and Waitress) would appear in all levels, due each level is added more cards. But now with the random couple cards system, any couple can appear in any level. Groom and Bride that would appear just in last level now maybe appears in level 1. This changes add more challenge to the game and makes it more appealling.

CAMERA STARTS IN ZOOM OUT MODE

We heard your feedfack and now you don´t need to zoom out to have a better view of the cards on table. Each level just starts with the camera in Zoom Out mode. You can still zoom in with your mouse wheel or pressing "+" on your keyboard and see the beautifull couples images better. Don´t forget you can move camera touching cursor on borders or right clicking your mouse to pan move. Also you can press "spacebar" and camera will jumps directly to your cursor.

LEVEL SIZES AND CARDS POSITIONS CHANGED:

We improved the size of levels, so you don´t need to move camera so much to find the cards, there is more levels you realy dont need to more camera since game just starts in zoom out mode now, you will still need move camera if you zoom in. On higher levels you still need to move camera even inzoom out mode due this levels is so big and challenging. And we didn´t want to expand zoom out  limits or the cards would be very small to be shown in the higher levels. But with the level sizes optiomizations and the new cards position on table you don´t need to move too much.

1 BUG FIXED:

The bug that changed the image of male vet card to another image was fixed. Now all sprites of male vet card is the correct.

CHANGES WE ARE WORKING FOR NEXT UPADTES:


 We are still working to improve our game, see below lists of our plans for next updates:

 Cards Names improving: Each card will have a real person name like "Andrew the King" or "Chris the Queen". If you want your name appear on any of our cards, please leave on comments of this post or in our community on Steam.

 In game ranking system: So you think your memory is awesome and you can find our 24 couples in just 1 minute?! Show us your skills! Each level will have ranks from E to A, and the perfect rank S. We are eager to see your screenshots in our community!

 Save and Load Systems: We are working to create a system that permmit you stop playing and continue playing it later.

 More levels: And with our save and load system, adding more levels, so you dont need to be hours in front your computer to finish all leves.

 Steam Achievements.

 Game translated versions to portuguese and spanish.

notes.title: SMALL UPDATE TO VERSION 1.0.0.5
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players,

An update was made in game, now you can control sound volumes in game. You can increase or decrease volumes of BGM and SFX in option page or in pause window.

Updates notes:

SMALL UPDATE TO VERSION 1.0.0.5 - Sound controls have been added to the game.


 The button Resolution in main menu was removed.
 The button Options was added in place of Resolution button. If you click Options buttons you go to Options page.
 In Option page you can set volumes and resolutions of the game.
 Sound controllers was added in Pause Window too. Now you can control BGM and sounds during gameplay.


I hope you all like this changes. Leaves on comments what you think could be changed or improved in Find My Love.

- Araújo Castle Team

notes.title: Fixed bugs found on previous version.
notes.content:
IMPROVEMENTS AND FIXED BUGS FOUND:

Hello All,

We made some improvements and fixed some small bugs found on version 1.0.0.3. Our team just fixed it in few hours after the update. 

See the patch notes about the bugs found and fixed below:

FIXED BUGS FOUND:


 A bug on all 3 Relax Mode Stage was found. This bug was making the game crashes when finishing the level. Now the bug was fixed and when you win any level you will be back to main menu.

 A bug on List of Cards page was found, that was preventing the camera to move down to see the other cards on the list. Now the bug was fixed and you can use arrows up and down to see the entire list.


IMPROVEMENTS:


 A improvement on BGM and sounds volume was made. Now the volume of all musics and sound effects is more balanced.


If you found more bugs that wasn´t found yet, please tells us on comments, we will fix it as soon as possible.

Thaks all! Now have fun finding the most lovely couples on Steam!

See you all!

notes.title: Small Update Patch Notes: Version 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Hello All,

There is about a week the game was launched and here comes the first small update. Some improvements was made on game, see the list below:


 Improved Splash Screen

 Improved "How To Play" page: Now the page is more clear and simple, explaining direct to the point the objectives of the game and also has a list of commands.

 Improved "You Win All Levels" page: Some corrections in the artwork that appears in this page was done, making this page more beautiful.


Thanks to all that have played Find My Love on this first week! We would love to hear your opinions about our game on comments, tells us anything you think about the game on comments and what you think could be improved. We will be working to improve the game and make you have fun.

Thanks all.
